name: Corporate blazer nameplate, cadet (black; CAP Crest; blank name/state; no grade insignia)
size_basis: Width reused from the CAP cadet nameplate (Vanguard CAP0599M, 3 3/8 in); 3.75:1 proportion read from CAPR 39-1 Fig A6-3. The regulation gives no dimension for the blazer nameplate.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left
documented: black nameplate with CAP Crest, last name and state/region/national by unit of assignment (CAPR 39-1 4.2.3.1.1.2, Fig A6-3)
grade insignia not allowed for cadets
worn with the top edge aligned with the top edge of the left breast pocket
assumed: CAP Crest is a redraw (assets: see ASSET_NOTES)
